confirmation_policy: All Train is previously studied development evidence, not an unseen holdout. Historical Valid / Valid and saved Valid artifacts prohibited.

feature_definitions.Size: Original z_size: -log(raw positive Close * backward EOD disclosed positive PIT shares), original 1/99 linear winsor, same-date median/0 imputation, sample z
feature_definitions.Illiquidity: Original z_amihud: abs(provided raw_return_1day)/positive raw TurnoverValue, trailing60 exchange-session mean/min40; original normalization unchanged
feature_definitions.SLOW_CONTROL: Original zscore(mean(z_size,z_amihud)); strict saved component/score and official weight/daily net bits
feature_definitions.conditional_sorts: Same-date average-tie percentile ceil(3*p), ties not split by Code; Size3=Small,2=Mid,1=Large; Illiq3=Illiquid,2=Mid,1=Liquid. Within fixed tercile re-rank other component into same3terciles; high-low equal-weight forward target mean; no portfolio costs/optimization.
feature_definitions.double_sort: Unconditional Size tercile x unconditional Illiquidity tercile 3x3, all normalized/imputed rows; raw missingness coverage separately recorded
feature_definitions.residualization: Daily intercept OLS normalized Size on normalized Illiquidity and reverse, analytic centered covariance/variance; zero-variance regressor slope0; target-free
feature_definitions.common: p=average-tie percentile per date; Rank=2*(p-mean(p)); COMMON=(SizeRank+IlliquidityRank)/2; DISAGREEMENT=(SizeRank-IlliquidityRank)/2. Check closeness vs SLOW, do not force parity between different definitions.
feature_definitions.residual_diagnostics: Daily average-tie quintiles ceil(5*p), equal-weight Q5-Q1 spread and gross Sharpe of spread (not official portfolio); no residual candidate
feature_definitions.overlap_groups: Exclusive: opposite signed official weights SIGNAL_DISAGREEMENT first; BOTH_LONG/BOTH_SHORT; SIZE_ONLY_LONG/ILLIQ_ONLY_LONG/SIZE_ONLY_SHORT/ILLIQ_ONLY_SHORT when other neutral; OTHER both neutral. All costs assigned current group incl exits.
feature_definitions.side_attribution: Original SLOW signed gross; cost per positive/negative sleeve turnover incl neutral exits. Current date bucket assigns exit cost even without active stock-day. Size,Illiquidity,joint are overlapping descriptors, never sum across descriptors.
feature_definitions.rank_variation: Daily mean absolute centered percentile rank change vs previous exchange date on common stock support; membership entries/exits on full date-code grid absent=neutral; daily contemporaneous correlations with original official SLOW turnover, not causal effects.

model: Fixed diagnostic-only target-free OLS/sorts; three official standalone books; no fitted return model
selection_rule: No adoption. Interpret A Size-dominant/B Illiquidity-dominant/C Complementary/D Common-factor dominant/E Interaction-dominant/F Inconclusive using all predefined diagnostics and stability. No numeric gate or tuning; allow qualified primary classification, do not force separation.
